needs.what: Presents are not re-paced to the display: the game keeps the present interval it asks for (often 30 fps).
The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
GPU timestamp reports are not per segment: a game that measures its GPU time may pick a wrong dynamic resolution.
